verses.text: A psalm by David, for remembrance. LORD, please don't rebuke me in your wrath or discipline me in your burning anger.
Your arrows have pierced me. Your hand is pressing hard on me.
Your anger has left my body sick, and my sin has left my bones without strength.
My wrongs are over my head. They're a load I can't carry.
My wounds stink and fester because of my foolish choices.
I'm doubled over in pain. I go around mourning all day.
My lower back burns, and my whole body feels sick.
I'm weak and badly bruised. I groan because my heart is in anguish.
Lord, you see everything I long for. You can hear every groan.
My heart pounds, my strength gives out, and even the light in my eyes is gone.
The people I love and my friends stay away because of what's happened to me. Even my family keeps its distance.
People who want me dead set traps. People who want to hurt me talk about how to do it and plot lies all day.
But I act like I didn't hear them. I keep my mouth closed and say nothing.
I'm like someone who hears nothing and has no answer to give.
My hope is in you, LORD. You'll answer me, Lord my God. 🙏
I said, “Don't let them gloat over me or act like they've won when I slip.”
I'm about to fall. The pain never lets up.
I'll own up to what I've done wrong. I'm sorry for my sin.
My enemies are strong, and there are lots of them. So many people hate me for no reason.
People who pay back good with evil turn against me because I keep going after what's good.
Don't leave me, LORD. My God, please stay close.
Come help me quick, Lord, my salvation.
